name: Midori Matcha Bar
tagline: A matcha bar on Shota Rustaveli: ceremonial matcha, hojicha and alternative coffee

listing.description: A website for a matcha bar, tea room or alternative café: dark green theme, labelled tins and a step-by-step whisking ritual.

seo.title: Midori — matcha bar and alternative coffee in Tashkent
seo.description: Ceremonial matcha from Uji, oat-milk matcha latte, hojicha and pour-over. A matcha bar at 41 Shota Rustaveli St; we also sell matcha and whisks for home.
seo.answer: Midori is a matcha bar at 41 Shota Rustaveli St (Yakkasaray), open 9:00–22:00 on weekdays and 10:00–23:00 at weekends. Matcha latte is 42,000 UZS, ceremonial matcha 48,000 UZS, pour-over 34,000 UZS. Matcha for home (30 g) starts at 165,000 UZS.

sections.title: Green as the first leaf
sections.subtitle: We whisk matcha with a bamboo chasen in front of you: thick usucha, a soft latte or an iced tonic. For coffee people — pour-over and AeroPress.

items: Oat milk at no extra cost

items.title: Sift
items.text: 2 g of matcha through a sieve — no lumps.

items.title: Pour
items.text: 70 ml of water at 75° — hotter makes matcha bitter.

items.title: Whisk
items.text: An “M”-shaped whisk for 15 seconds until frothy.

items.title: Drink
items.text: Right away, while the foam is alive.

items.title: Whisk and bowl
items.text: A bamboo chasen and a ceramic bowl.

items.title: Workshop
items.text: An hour with a barista: learn to whisk at home.

items.label: seats inside and on the terrace

items.quote: Finally matcha that doesn’t taste like grass. I took the kit home and learned at the workshop.
items.author: Sevara B.

items.quote: Hojicha latte in the evening instead of coffee — and I sleep fine.
items.author: Jasur N.

items.q: How much caffeine is in matcha?
items.a: About half an espresso’s worth, but the lift is gentler and longer.
Oat milk at no charge; coconut and almond +6,000 UZS.
Yes, via “Order to go” or Telegram — ready when you arrive.

items.q: How do I store matcha at home?
items.a: In the fridge in a sealed tin, and finish it within a month of opening.
